    ["/usr/games/stockfish"],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1,
)

    proc.stdin.write(f"position fen {fen}\n")
    proc.stdin.write("go depth 30\n")
    proc.stdin.flush()
    best, score = None, None
    while True:
        line = proc.stdout.readline()
        if not line:
            break
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("info") and " depth 30 " in line and " score " in line and " pv " in line:
            m = re.search(r"score (mate \d+|-\d+|\d+)", line)
